name: Camping Seemühle
beschreibung: Camping Seemühle is located in Kössen in the Tiroler Unterland. The site is in the immediate vicinity of the lake and offers pitches for motorhomes and tents. The sanitary facilities are modern and barrier-free. Guests can enjoy regional dishes in the adjacent restaurant. In the surrounding area, hiking and cycling trails invite you to activities. The campsite is a suitable starting point for excursions into the Tiroler Bergwelt.
